title: Imaginarity witnessing enhancement via spectral norms of witnesses
summary: Quantum imaginarity is an essential physical resource that underpins key functionalities of modern quantum technologies. We improve imaginarity witnessing via the prior knowledge of imaginarity-witness operators. To this end, we derive a rigorous upper bound on the maximum expectation value of an imaginarity witness operator over the set of all free (real) quantum states, which is given by the spectral norm of the real component of the corresponding witness operator.
